title: A Mountain Lion Can Leap 40 Feet in a Single Jump

scenes.text: A mountain lion can leap 40 feet in a single jump.
It creeps within about 30 feet, then pounces.
It lands on its prey's back and finishes it with a neck bite.
Males can weigh up to 200 pounds.
Then it drags the kill more than a thousand feet.
Forty feet is about the length of a school bus.

description:
A mountain lion can leap 40 feet in a single jump.
Its powerful back legs let it clear 18 feet straight up, and it ambushes from about 30 feet away.
What's the biggest jump you've ever made?
first_comment: Bonus: it can drag its kill over a thousand feet. Would you ever want to meet one?
